plan.open.description: open the sdc.plan case once the specification case ended passed

release.open.description: open the sdc.release case once every story case ended passed

roadmap.read.description: copy the roadmap approval record of the sdc.direction case into this case, unchanged; it approves nothing, and the record keeps the producer and roadmap revision it was approved with. Only while this case holds no roadmap approval record about the current roadmap revision: a second copy with another result would leave roadmap.approved unknown for good. A new roadmap revision sets the old record aside and makes it admissible again

spec.gate.description: run the ESS gate over the current specification revision; only while no gate run is recorded about it: a second record with another result would leave gate.passed unknown for good

spec.open.description: open the sdc.spec case for the epic

stories.open.description: open one sdc.story case per AEP story, once the planning case ended passed

roadmap.description: the roadmap the epic belongs to

spec.description: the epic's ESS specification; its revision is its spec digest

gate.checked.description: an ESS gate run is recorded about the current specification revision, whatever its result

gate.passed.description: the ESS gate passes on the current specification revision

plan.opened.description: the planning case was opened for the current epic revision

release.opened.description: the release case was opened for the current epic revision

roadmap.approved.description: the current roadmap revision is approved

roadmap.copied.description: a roadmap approval record about the current roadmap revision is in this case, whatever its result

spec.opened.description: the specification case was opened for the current epic revision

stories.opened.description: the story cases were opened for the current epic revision

case_outcome.description: the outcome of one child case, one record per child: passed or another outcome of the child's protocol, open while the child runs

ess_gate.description: the ESS gate over a specification revision: `ess specify validate --strict-requires`, `ess specify compile`, `ess verify conform synthesize` with 0 refusals and no `UNMAPPED:` marker, run as one program; passed only when all four pass, failed otherwise

plan_opened.description: the record that the planning case was opened for an epic revision

release_opened.description: the record that the release case was opened for an epic revision

roadmap_approval.description: a person's approval of a roadmap revision; its result is approved

spec_opened.description: the record that the specification case was opened for an epic revision

stories_opened.description: the record that one story case per AEP story was opened for an epic revision

gate.required.description: the ESS gate passes on the current specification revision

release.required.description: the release case was opened and every child ended passed

not_delivered.description: a child case opened before the release ended other than passed (the specification abandoned, a story dropped); the children form keeps that outcome for every later revision, so the case ends here, and the root case ends not_delivered with it

not_released.description: the release case ended other than passed (withheld, for instance after its publication was refused, or rolled back). The release case is opened only once every earlier child passed, so the release is the child that failed; the case ends here, and the root case ends not_delivered with it

passed.description: the release case was opened, every child ended passed, and the ESS gate passes on the current specification revision

protocol.description: Deliver one epic of the approved roadmap (docs/phases.md steps 7 to 10). The epic case opens child cases in order, each once every earlier child ended passed: sdc.spec (the ESS specification, authored, reused or reconstructed, until the ESS gate passes), sdc.plan (the AEP stories), one sdc.story case per story (opened together), then sdc.release. No action is admissible before the roadmap is approved, and none after the specification stage before the ESS gate passes on the current specification revision. The case ends passed once the release case ended passed and the gate still passes, or abandoned on an explicit decision; when a child case ended other than passed it ends not_delivered (a child before the release) or not_released (the release), without a person.
